# The Kitchen Studio

> Custom kitchen, bathroom and living room furniture showroom in Glyfada, Athens, Greece. We design and install bespoke kitchen furniture, bathroom cabinets, tiles, wardrobes, doors and living room furniture.

## About

The Kitchen Studio has designed and manufactured custom kitchen furniture in Glyfada since 2000, more than 20 years of experience. Every kitchen is designed in 3D before ordering and built to measure, using Blum and Hettich drawer and hinge systems, Corian solid surfaces, natural wood, MDF and lacquered finishes. We serve Glyfada, Voula, Vouliagmeni, Varkiza, Elliniko, Alimos, Palaio Faliro, Argyroupoli and the wider Attica region. Our work has been featured in Villas by ek magazine. Installation is carried out by our own crew, with technical support after the sale, and we also work directly with architects and interior designers.

The site is in Greek (default) and English (under /en/).

## Services

- [Kitchen Furniture](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/kitchens/): Modern, classic and Corian kitchen designs, custom-built and installed
- [Modern Kitchens](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/kitchens/modern-kitchens/): Contemporary minimalist kitchen furniture with clean lines and premium materials
- [Classic Kitchens](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/kitchens/classic-kitchens/): Traditional wood cabinetry with timeless detailing and craftsmanship
- [Corian Kitchens](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/kitchens/corian-kitchens/): Seamless integrated Corian countertops and surfaces
- [Bathroom Furniture](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/bath/): Custom bathroom cabinets, vanity units and Corian bath solutions
- [Bathroom Cabinets](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/bath/bath-furnitures/): Custom-built bathroom furniture combining function and modern aesthetics
- [Corian Bath](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/bath/corian-bath/): Corian surfaces for a seamless, hygienic bathroom
- [Tiles](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/tiles/): Porcelain, ceramic and natural stone tiles in a wide range of sizes and finishes
- [Wardrobes](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/wardrobes/): Custom bedroom wardrobes with hinged and sliding doors
- [Doors](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/doors/): Interior doors in wood, glass and metal finishes
- [Living Room Furniture](https://www.thekitchenstudio.gr/living/): Bespoke living room furniture design and installation
